name: yaxel
caption:
PICK 11 🎮🏀 Junior college. Then UAB. Then a title at Michigan. Now he's our starter.

• 3 years at Arizona Western, a junior college: NJCAA all-time record 870 rebounds
• 2026: national champion and Big Ten Player of the Year at Michigan
• 2026 draft: we take him at #11
• Rookie year so far: 21.2 PPG, 7.2 RPG, 40.4 3P%, 37 against the Clippers

Steal of the draft? 👇
